items.problem: Bootstrap omitted linked shared files and left a deterministic namespace mapping manual.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered entries for CS0246/WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 and Colors; skill-defects.json item 1; skill-coverage-gaps.json item 1.
items.root_cause: The mechanical inventory used only recursive filesystem enumeration, and its safe rewrite set covered XAML namespaces but not Colors.
items.change: Resolve common csproj properties, copy supported Include/Link items to Link paths, deduplicate mapping rows, constrain links to the target, and rewrite Windows.UI.Colors mechanically.
items.expected_effect: Shared XAML/code/assets are present before triage, typed pages generate normally, and color constants do not consume build retries.
items.falsifiable_check: On a rerun bootstrap copies Scenario1_ConfigureMobileHotspot.xaml, MainPage.xaml, and Styles/Styles.xaml; mapping has rows for them; the first build has no missing scenario type, typed DataTemplate, or Colors errors.

items.problem: Unavailable-device fallback removed the entire feature surface and caused both scored features to fail.
items.evidence: migration-score.json features 1-2 and discrepancies.json missing-controls entries; skill-defects.json item 2.
items.root_cause: Existing guidance explicitly prioritized swapping out main content rather than preserving fidelity.
items.change: Correct defensive UI guidance to retain named controls and automation properties, disable only unavailable actions, and show an adjacent status.
items.expected_effect: Hardware absence remains understandable without erasing the migrated interaction surface.
items.falsifiable_check: On a device without hotspot support, UIA still finds SsidTextBox, PassphraseTextBox, BandComboBox, AuthenticationComboBox, Apply changes, Discard changes, and MobileHotspotToggle; actions are disabled/status-qualified as appropriate.

items.problem: Build, launch-layout, analyzer attribution, and minimum-contract guidance assumed outdated tooling/defaults.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json items 3-4; session-log.txt lines 3340-3403, 3892-3900, and CA1416 lines 3861-3869.
items.root_cause: Workflow prose and launch lookup lagged the native dotnet build path, while project guidance did not tie minimum versions to retained API contracts.
items.change: Use dotnet build in SKILL.md, let Test-AppLaunch search bin/Debug as well as Platform layouts, update validator/pattern wording, and add TargetPlatformMinVersion/CA1416 reconciliation guidance.
items.expected_effect: The prescribed command exists, launch finds native build output, and retained APIs target a valid Windows contract.
items.falsifiable_check: A default dotnet build is accepted by Test-AppLaunch, no 'winapp build was not matched' error occurs, and the rerun has no CA1416 warnings for APIs required by the migrated feature.
